detail.sDescription: A modified N-TEC 5 with a combat sling to improve movement whilst in marksmanship, a medium magazine extension, and slightly increased accuracy in marksmanship mode.

Receiver Modification -

A Joker manufactured sling designed to act as a stability aid while moving. This allows the user to walk or run faster while in marksmanship mode.
